hypotheses.T0_one_effect_ray_is_oracle_sufficient: Per-example projection onto the frozen generic newline write ray has Fisher fidelity >=0.70 on every corpus.
hypotheses.T1_wikitext_failure_is_mostly_scale: Oracle per-example scaling improves WikiText fidelity over the fixed calibrated prototype by >=0.20.
hypotheses.T2_state_change_predicts_contraction: A FineWeb-trained linear predictor of the write-ray coefficient has Pearson correlation >=0.30 and positive R2 on every corpus.
hypotheses.T3_predicted_contraction_is_causally_suf: State-predicted ray patches have fidelity >=0.60 and are within 0.15 of oracle-ray fidelity on every corpus.
hypotheses.T4_state_contraction_repairs_wikitext: The state-predicted patch improves WikiText fidelity over the fixed generic prototype by >=0.15.
hypotheses.T5_real_state_mapping_beats_shuffled_con: Predicted-contraction fidelity exceeds a shuffled-target predictor by >=0.20 on every corpus.
